samples.question: The blue shape is one connected corridor network. The dark disk is a rover. The rover may slide anywhere, in any direction, as long as its entire disk stays on blue; it may not shrink, and it may not leave the blue area. A dot counts as reached when the rover center can arrive exactly on that dot. How many of the three colored dots can the rover reach? Answer 0, 1, 2, or 3.
